article.title: Pine Labs在印度推出商戶AI代理，Google廣告支出前須先批准
article.title_en: Pine Labs rolls out merchant AI agents in India with approval before Google ad spend
article.summary: Pine Labs宣布在Pine Labs One加入Guide及Marketer Agent，讓印度商戶查詢營業資料並設定Google廣告。
article.summary_en: Pine Labs announced Guide and Marketer Agent in Pine Labs One for Indian merchants to query business data and set up Google campaigns.
highlights: Guide涵蓋門店銷售、交易、結算及退款的自然語言問答。
廣告須商戶先批准才承諾支出；其他LLM渠道仍屬規劃。
highlights_en: Guide supports natural-language questions on sales, transactions, settlements and refunds.
Merchants approve campaigns before spend; other LLM discovery channels remain planned.
article.why: 營業資料與廣告設定放進商戶應用程式後，小型零售團隊可先把具體門店目標轉成活動，再決定是否批准支出。
article.why_en: Connected business data and campaign setup let small retailers turn store objectives into proposals before deciding whether to authorize spend.
article.next_step: 已獲接入的印度商戶可選一間門店，核對Guide銷售回覆，再檢查Google活動的關鍵字、素材及預算，逐項批准。
article.next_step_en: Eligible Indian merchants can choose one store, reconcile Guide's sales answers and inspect keywords, creative and budget before approving a Google campaign.
article.detail: 消息按Pine Labs公司公告轉載整理。Marketer Agent由Gemini支援，處理關鍵字研究、素材與活動設定；公司稱正在印度逐步推出。編輯建議把營業資料核對與投放批准分開記錄，避免問答看似合理便直接接受預算。公司對交易歸因及成效的描述未經本刊驗證，本篇沒有把後續渠道或代理商店的計劃寫成已全面提供。
article.detail_en: This is a reproduced issuer announcement. Gemini supports keyword research, creative and campaign setup during the India rollout. Record data reconciliation separately from spend approval rather than accepting a budget because an answer appears plausible. Attribution and performance are not independently validated; future channels and marketplace plans are not current access.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
